source.check: returned unopposed (Derry Journal, 7 January 1927: nominated and returned unopposed on 5 January)

note: Annual retirement of two councillors in each of the five wards of Londonderry Corporation; nominations Wednesday 5 January 1927. All ten were returned unopposed, so there was no poll; the only change was in the South Ward, where Charles M'Gahey replaced Ross Shields, who did not seek re-election (Derry Journal, 7 January 1927). The label is given once for the pair. M'Gahey, a new member, was a brother of William M'Gahey, J.P. Returned unopposed.
